description: This bar chart illustrates the number of floating point operations (FLOPs) required by various fine-tuning methods. The horizontal axis displays the method labels: Full FT, TAG, LoRA, MTL-FT, QLoRA, and Ours, with "Ours" visually distinguished by a green bar, while the other bars are orange. The horizontal axis is labeled "TAG", "FT", "TAG", "LoRA", "MTL-FT", "QLoRA", and "Ours", and appears to be ordered alphabetically. The vertical axis represents the number of FLOPs, labeled “# FLOPs”, and uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 10<sup>18</sup> to 10<sup>20</sup>, with tick labels at intervals of 10<sup>19</sup>. The bar for Full FT reaches approximately 1.9 x 10<sup>20</sup> FLOPs, the tallest bar on the chart, while the bar for Ours reaches approximately 6 x 10<sup>18</sup> FLOPs, the shortest. The other bars have lengths of about 1.7 x 10<sup>20</sup> (TAG), 1.6 x 10<sup>20</sup> (LoRA), 1.5 x 10<sup>20</sup> (MTL-FT), and 1.1 x 10<sup>19</sup> (QLoRA). No bars are emphasized beyond the use of color.
